messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started to production: rollout/redwood-runtime v2.14.1 -> v2.15.0. Change window 30m. Expect brief API latencies up to 2s during traffic switchover. Notifying ops channels.

maya: Thanks. Can we draft a 1-line statuspage update + email blurb for customers? Need something we can publish within 10m. @alex can you confirm if we're pinning Dedicated to v2.14.1 during the rollout?

alex: Yes — dedicated pools will be pinned to v2.14.1 until canary passes. We'll route 10% to 2.15 for 15m then ramp. Rollback policy: automatic canary hold + manual full rollback if error rate > 2% or p50 latency > 1.5s.

jordan: Watching canary now. If we see higher latencies we hold and triage. Oncallpager ready.

li: Draft statuspage: "We are deploying a platform update to improve inference throughput. During a short change window we may experience transient increased latency for some requests. We are monitoring and will update here." Short email blurb: "Planned maintenance: brief latency increase possible during rollout of performance update. No customer action required. Status updates will be posted to our status page."

maya: Nice. Shorten statuspage to one line for the banner: "Planned deployment: brief, monitored latency impact possible (no action required)." Email subject: "Planned maintenance — brief latency impact (no action required)". Add CTA: link to status.redwood.ai/incident/1769994321 once live.

alex: Also add note for Dedicated customers: "If you require zero-latency impact, contact support to schedule non-overlapping maintenance or enable pinned capacity." I'll coordinate with account owners.

statusbot: Status page draft published (private): https://status.redwood.ai/drafts/1769994321 (available to ops for review).

deploy-bot: Canary traffic pushed: 10% -> v2.15. Observing metrics stream.

jordan: Canary graphs: slight p99 spike at +12m, p50 stable. Error rate still within threshold. Holding at 10% for another 10m.

alex: Noted. Leaving dedicated pin in place. Preparing rollback steps: memory leak mitigations are backout-able via feature-flag toggles.

maya: Ready to publish status banner in 5m unless we hit rollback. Final banner text proposed: "Planned deployment in progress — brief, monitored latency increases possible. We will update at completion." Approve? :eyes:

li: Approve. Also adding note for customers on dedicated: "No data plane changes for pinned pools."

deploy-bot: Canary hold triggered: observed error spike at +19m. Error rate 3.1% (>2%). Initiating canary rollback to v2.14.1 for canary cohort.

jordan: Rolling back canary as ordered. Taking canary hosts out of rotation.

alex: We're pausing the full rollout. Investigating the source — early suspect: new KV cache eviction change. Collecting logs.

maya: Update status banner to reflect rollback and investigation. Proposed text: "Deployment paused — we detected elevated error rates during canary and rolled back the canary cohort. No customer-facing failures expected. We are investigating and will post updates here."

statusbot: Status page updated (public): https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1769994321 — "Deployment paused after canary rollback; investigating."

li: Customer email snippet for rollback: "We paused today's deployment after detecting elevated errors in a subset of traffic. We rolled back those changes and are investigating; no action required. We'll share an update within 2 hours."

maya: Sent to customers on the affected list (dedicated and hosted) — using the snippet above. Copy in #support-ops.

deploy-bot: Canary fully rolled back at 1769994465. All canary nodes are at v2.14.1.

jordan: Confirming p50/p99 back to baseline. Monitoring for residuals.

alex: Opening a release-blocking issue: RH-9872. Steps: reproduce, bisect cache change, create quickfix or revert, run extended canary. I'll own the rollout reattempt once fixed.

maya: Closing loop on comms: status page will remain with investigating banner until root cause confirmed. Planned customer follow-up: summary + ETA for next attempt once we have fix.

li: I'll prepare an incident postmortem draft and customer-facing RCA template. Assigning follow-ups to eng and SRE.

maya: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source for comms. :heart:

statusbot: Thread archived for postmortem bundling.
